page.content:
Astrix Alixan (b. 1670s) was a Gryffindor student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the 1680s and 1690s. He was once Captain of the Gryffindor Quidditch team from 1688 to 1692.

page.overview:
Who is Astrix Alixan?

Astrix Alixan (b. 1670s) was a Gryffindor student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the 1680s and 1690s. He was once Captain of the Gryffindor Quidditch team from 1688 to 1692.
